prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with wrist fracture after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 19 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1281; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a sideswipe collision that occurred while the patient was changing lanes. Imaging confirmed a distal radius fracture of the wrist, and the mechanism described is consistent with the injury observed. The patient has no known prior injury to the same area. Over the course of care, the patient attended 19 visits, which is somewhat longer than typically expected for a fracture of this type. Examination findings include tenderness and reduced grip strength on the affected side that support the diagnosis, while neurovascular testing and range-of-motion results on the unaffected joints were within normal limits. Immobilization was followed by graduated physical therapy, and progress has been steady though slower than anticipated. Billed services reflect the treatment delivered, with no repeated or duplicate charges identified in the record. Ongoing monitoring and a home exercise program are planned.
